About Seafood Heaven

Located at 7473 N Shepherd Dr, Houston, TX 77091, Seafood Heaven offers a delightful dining experience that stands out for its exceptional food, great service, and welcoming atmosphere. This family-owned, Black-owned gem has quickly become a local favorite, known for its delicious seafood dishes and a menu that caters to all tastes.

One of the key highlights of Seafood Heaven is the variety of fresh seafood options available. Whether you're in the mood for crispy cornmeal-breaded fish or flavorful, perfectly cooked shrimp, each dish is prepared with care and attention to detail. The quality of the fish is often praised, with many visitors noting the authentic taste that brings a touch of Southern charm to Houston. The restaurant's commitment to using fresh ingredients ensures every bite is packed with flavor.

The ambiance at Seafood Heaven is equally impressive, with a clean and inviting space that makes for a comfortable dining experience. The friendly and attentive staff adds to the welcoming environment, always ready to assist in making your meal choice easier and more enjoyable. Guests have appreciated the staff’s helpfulness in recommending dishes, which makes first-time visitors feel right at home.

Seafood Heaven’s homemade desserts, especially their cakes, are another standout. Made from scratch, the cakes add a sweet finishing touch to an already fantastic meal. With reasonable prices and a focus on quality, Seafood Heaven has become a go-to spot for seafood lovers in the area.

Whether you're stopping by for a quick bite or a more relaxed meal, Seafood Heaven promises to deliver an unforgettable experience. Their focus on quality, combined with their friendly atmosphere, makes it a must-visit destination for both locals and newcomers to the Houston area.

Reviews

“ Seafood Heaven has the best fried fish I've EVER had. Everything is delicious, and the prices are affordable. My family loves it, so we've been ordering here regularly during the pandemic. ”

Richandra Nickerson-Ukpong

“ My first time here. Staff very friendly and attentive. Nice a very clean establishment. BLACK OWNED. My food is amazing, great variety of food for everyone. Cake (made from scratch) I will return and bring people ... ”

Mz Harris

“ I was very satisfied with the service. I used the drive thru and ordered my 12 fried shrimp with fries and hush puppies, 2 bacon cheese burger baskets and peach cobbler. Everything was freshly prepared and for waiting we were given free drinks. All the food was seasoned to my taste so, I am fully satisfied. Thanks to BOR for recommending this establishment. ”

Princella Rue

“ Food was amazing! The lady at the front counter was extremely nice and she helped me decide on what type of fish to get. Their fish is really good, it bring cornmeal breaded makes it a plus. I’m from Arkansas, and that’s how we do it back home. Oh and it’s black owned so that makes it twice as sweet! Definitely a must try. ”

Zalyn Meanus

“ Pretty good first time here don't eat fried foods much. But it was a good treat I'll maybe try the boiled next time the corn was the best. ”

Ronecka and Desmond White

“ I am 56. I have had plenty seafood. This fish was delicious. Nicely decorated restaurant with a "gone fishing" theme. ”

Nights In Egypt

“ Awesome food and service. Reasonable prices. Favorite new spot. Everything was good! ”

G McCardell

“ food and service were on point! I got the turkey necks and they did not disappoint Will return! and it's black owned ”

Maria Lewis

Seafood Heaven

Seafood Heaven in Houston, TX is a Black-owned gem offering a variety of delicious seafood dishes. From Po-Boys and wings to breakfast options, this spot has something for everyone. With outdoor seating, delivery, drive-through, and dine-in options available, Seafood Heaven is perfect for families. Come enjoy a meal at this friendly establishment where the staff are attentive and the prices are reasonable. Don't miss out on their signature cornmeal breaded fish - a true Southern delight!
